heading: INT. RIVER ROCK QUARRY - FIRST-AID TENT - DAY

units.text: INT. RIVER ROCK QUARRY - FIRST-AID TENT - DAY
A canvas tent pitched at the lip of a limestone quarry.
Dust drifts through the open flap.
A stretcher bed, a cooler of saline bags, a battery lantern.
DR. SADIE TREMBLAY, forties, crouches over a pale quarryman, ARTUR NOWAK, who lies on the stretcher clutching his thigh.
A tourniquet is tight above the knee.
A young medic, JUNE ABERNATHY, kneels at his side with a roll of gauze.
She is shaking.
Dr. Tremblay takes the gauze from her without a word and presses it to the wound.
Artur howls through his teeth.
Pressure. Hold it right there.
units.name: DR. TREMBLAY

units.text: He's losing it. He's going grey.
units.name: JUNE

units.text: He grabs for June's wrist and she grabs his.
They hold each other's grip.
Don't let me go.
units.name: ARTUR

units.text: I've got you.
units.name: JUNE

units.text: Artur, look at me.
units.name: DR. TREMBLAY

units.text: I can't feel my foot.
units.name: ARTUR

units.text: Dr. Tremblay cuts the trouser leg with scissors.
She reads the wound, and the tension in her shoulders eases by an inch.
It missed the artery. Tourniquet did its job. June, loosen it a quarter turn.
units.name: DR. TREMBLAY

units.text: June turns the windlass, her fingers steadying as she works.
Artur lets his head fall back.
Is it bad?
units.name: ARTUR

units.text: It's a deep gash. It's going to hurt for weeks and you're going to keep the leg.
units.name: DR. TREMBLAY

units.text: He closes his eyes and laughs, a cracked sound.
June sits back on her heels and wipes her face with the back of a bloody glove.
